_doc: release-content-expectations.json — content markers a PUBLISHED release
artifact must actually contain, keyed module -> version -> markers.
Consumed by canary/leg-release-content.sh (see its header for the two
stale-release incidents this exists to prevent).
Marker types:
qml_grep           strings that must appear in the files extracted from
EVERY shipped variant of the .lgx (swap_ui ships its
QML sources inside the artifact).
binary_strings     strings that must appear in the native plugin
libraries (.so/.dylib) of EVERY shipped variant —
asserted via a `strings`-equivalent byte scan.
required_ancestors git commit SHAs that must be ancestors of the release
tag's target commit (catches a release dispatched on
a stale ref even before looking inside the artifact).
NO SILENT FALLBACK (issue #165): every version in swap-module/metadata.json
and swap-ui/metadata.json MUST have an exact entry here — canary/
check-expectations-coverage.py enforces that in CI (rust-checks), in `make
preflight`, and before every canary-channel build. When a PUBLISHED version
still has no exact entry, leg-release-content.sh asserts the HIGHEST mapped
version <= the released one AND grades the release FAIL for the missing
entry: a release must assert its own content. The map froze at 0.4.2 while
0.4.3-0.4.5 shipped, and two of 0.4.2's markers described UI text #140/#145
had already replaced, so every release after 0.4.2 was graded against a
stale description — and nothing said the map was behind. A release OLDER
than every mapped version predates this map entirely: the leg then runs
structural checks only (archive extracts, all variants present, manifest
matches) and says so loudly in its evidence.
When you add a feature worth guarding, add (or extend) the entry for the
NEXT version to be released, using literals verified to exist in the
source (and, for binary_strings, reachable from swap-ffi so they survive
into the compiled plugin).
MARKER SELECTION RULE (learned from the 0.4.0 cut): binary_strings must be
plain, non-format!() literals of >= ~15 chars. Shorter literals get compiled
into split immediate stores on x86-64 (trial-ops/1 was mov-immediate'd and
absent as contiguous bytes from linux-amd64 while present on arm64/darwin),
and format! strings fragment at every {} placeholder. Verify a candidate
marker against a REAL built artifact for all variants before committing it.
